description.value: The study examined neural cue reactivity and primed emotion- and alcohol-related conflict processing in abstinent alcohol-dependent patients and age-matched controls using functional MRI during a Stroop Match-to-Sample task.

value: we expected greater midbrain-limbic-striatal activation to alcohol-related and intrinsically salient emotional stimuli (e.g., angry or happy faces) and less frontal cortical executive control system activation in ALC than controls.
we expected that negative semantic priming will help ALC engage inhibitory frontoparietal executive control systems and overcome the prepotent midbrain-limbic-striatal cue reactivity response.
